package nullfields_test

import (
	"context"
	"encoding/json/v2"
	"net"
	"strings"
	"testing"

	"github.com/stretchr/testify/require"
	"google.golang.org/grpc"
	"google.golang.org/grpc/credentials/insecure"
	"google.golang.org/grpc/test/bufconn"

	"example.com/grpcnullfields/gen/grpc/nullfields/client"
	pb "example.com/grpcnullfields/gen/grpc/nullfields/pb"
	"example.com/grpcnullfields/gen/grpc/nullfields/server"
	svc "example.com/grpcnullfields/gen/nullfields"
)

func TestSelectedNullAndAbsence(t *testing.T) {
	listener := bufconn.Listen(1024 * 1024)
	srv := grpc.NewServer()
	echo := func(_ context.Context, value any) (any, error) {
		return value, nil
	}
	pb.RegisterNullfieldsServer(srv, server.New(&svc.Endpoints{Echo: echo, Root: echo}, nil))
	go func() {
		if err := srv.Serve(listener); err != nil {
			t.Error(err)
		}
	}()
	t.Cleanup(srv.Stop)
	conn, err := grpc.NewClient("passthrough:///bufconn", grpc.WithContextDialer(func(context.Context, string) (net.Conn, error) {
		return listener.Dial()
	}), grpc.WithTransportCredentials(insecure.NewCredentials()))
	require.NoError(t, err)
	t.Cleanup(func() {
		require.NoError(t, conn.Close())
	})
	c := client.NewClient(conn)
	for _, wire := range []string{
		`{"required":null}`,
		`{"required":null,"optional":null,"list":[{"choice":null},{"choice":"text"}],"map":{"n":{"choice":null},"s":{"choice":"text"}}}`,
		`{"required":"text","optional":0}`,
	} {
		t.Run(wire, func(t *testing.T) {
			var payload svc.Record
			require.NoError(t, json.Unmarshal([]byte(wire), &payload))
			require.NotEmpty(t, payload.Required.Kind())
			if strings.Contains(wire, `"optional"`) {
				require.NotEmpty(t, payload.Optional.Kind())
			} else {
				require.Empty(t, payload.Optional.Kind())
			}
			result, err := c.Echo()(t.Context(), &payload)
			require.NoError(t, err)
			require.Equal(t, &payload, result)
			output, err := json.Marshal(result, json.Deterministic(true))
			require.NoError(t, err)
			require.JSONEq(t, wire, string(output))
		})
	}
	for _, wire := range []string{`null`, `"text"`, `0`} {
		var payload svc.Choice
		require.NoError(t, json.Unmarshal([]byte(wire), &payload))
		result, err := c.Root()(t.Context(), &payload)
		require.NoError(t, err)
		require.Equal(t, &payload, result)
	}
	_, err = c.Echo()(t.Context(), &svc.Record{})
	require.Error(t, err)
}
